# Workspace guidance

Adapt this file for each project. Keep only guidance that should apply to most Copilot work in that repository.

## General

- Inspect the relevant code and follow existing project patterns before making changes.
- Keep changes focused on the request; avoid unrelated refactors.
- Explain assumptions when requirements are ambiguous rather than inventing project behavior.
- Do not add secrets, credentials, or personal data to source files.

## Changes and verification

- Update related documentation when behavior or setup changes.
- Run the smallest relevant test, lint, or build command after changing code. If a check cannot be run, say why.
- Report the files changed and the checks performed, including any failures.

## Project-specific details

Add the project's language, architecture, formatting, build, and test conventions here. Prefer links to maintained project documentation over duplicating it.
